question: Does checking the final native switch value resolve setup failures while the in-app check confirms the requested flags and restoration?
scope: testConfigureAccessibilitySettings on iPhone 17; recover original flags, all three on with landscape, then original flags off with portrait. No coverage batch.
expectedEvidence: Native summaries, logs, switch waiter/result timing, final in-app ACE_SETTINGS_RESULT values, screenshots on failure, original boot state restored.
rule: No timeout increase or fixed wait. Native audits untouched. Final observed switch value is mandatory, then independent in-app flag and orientation match.
